thread.title: Stock-index futures pare solid gains after Friday jobs report - MarketWatch

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Stock-index futures pare solid gains after Friday jobs report - MarketWatch
text:
U.S. stock-index futures pared early gains after the headline number for employment in October came in better than expected and the rate of unemployment was unchanged. The Labor Department said 250,000 jobs were created last month and the unemployment rate held at 3.7%. Futures for the Dow Jones Industrial Average YMZ8, -0.38% were up 0.5%, a rise of 189 points, to reach 25,510, while those for the S&P 500 index ESZ8, -0.57% advanced 0.5% at 2,752. Futures for the Nasdaq-100 were lower at 7,062, declining 0.2%, weighed by a decline in shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, -6.63% which disappointed investors on its call to discuss quarterly results late Thursday.
